Fonts bundled with this demonstration (subset to Latin, WOFF):

- Inter (regular, medium, semibold) — by Rasmus Andersson, SIL Open Font License 1.1
  https://github.com/rsms/inter
- Lora (roman and italic, variable) — by Cyreal, SIL Open Font License 1.1
  https://github.com/cyrealtype/Lora-Cyrillic

The SIL Open Font License permits bundling, subsetting and redistribution with
software, provided the fonts are not sold on their own and the licence travels
with them. Include the full OFL text (https://openfontlicense.org) before any
public deployment.
